name: Mixed Assessment
summary: A mini-quiz of 2-6 questions drawn from different mechanic types. Each question uses a different interaction pattern (tap, drag, type, slide), testing the same topic from multiple angles.

aiGenerability.notes: AI generates the full question set by picking eligible mechanics and producing content that conforms to each sub-mechanic's contentSchema. High generability since it composes existing well-defined schemas rather than inventing new formats.

title.description: Optional title for the assessment (e.g., 'Quick Recap', 'Check Your Knowledge'). If omitted, defaults to 'Quick Check'.

questions.description: Array of 2-6 questions. Each question specifies its mechanic type and content conforming to that mechanic's contentSchema.

mechanicId.description: Slug of the sub-mechanic for this question. Must be one of the eligible individual mechanics: true-false, fill-in-blank, multiple-choice, image-recognition, matching-pairs, word-builder, sequence-reorder, timeline, categorization, numerical-slider, labeling, scenario-question, odd-one-out, find-the-error, cause-effect, hot-text, ranking, pros-cons, comparison-table, flashcard.

content.description: Content object conforming to the specified mechanic's contentSchema. E.g., if mechanicId is 'multiple-choice', this must have question, options, correctIndex, explanation.

_factRefs.description: Fact IDs this question tests (for traceability to fact sheet).

showProgress.description: Whether to show 'Question 1 of 4' progress indicator. Defaults to true.

shuffleOrder.description: Whether to randomize question order at runtime. Defaults to false (preserve authored order for Bloom's progression).

ux.mobileNotes: Questions presented one at a time, full-width. Each question renders its sub-mechanic's native UI (e.g., MC renders option buttons, sequence-reorder renders draggable list). Progress bar at top. After answering, feedback shows briefly, then auto-advances to next question. Summary screen at end with score and per-question results.

ageAdaptations.8-10: 2-3 questions max. Only use simple mechanics: true-false, multiple-choice, numerical-slider, matching-pairs (3-4 pairs). Large touch targets. Big, encouraging feedback between questions. Summary uses stars or emoji, not percentages.
ageAdaptations.11-13: 3-5 questions. Can include sequence-reorder, categorization, fill-in-blank. Standard feedback. Summary shows score as fraction (3/5) and brief per-question review.
ageAdaptations.14-16: 4-6 questions. Full range of eligible mechanics. Concise feedback. Summary shows percentage, per-question breakdown, and links to relevant content for missed questions.
